summary.text: Kathy Hochul is the incumbent Governor of New York, seeking a second full term with running mate Adrienne Adams. An attorney and former congressional aide, she held local office on the Hamburg Town Board and as Erie County Clerk, served one term in the U.S. House (2011–2013) and was Lieutenant Governor from 2015 to 2021 before becoming governor in August 2021 upon Andrew Cuomo's resignation; she won a full term in 2022. As governor she paused and then restarted congestion pricing at a reduced toll, signed gun-safety and immigration-limiting legislation, and signed budgets that extended the state's higher tax rate on top earners while ruling out new broad-based income or business tax increases.

paragraphs.text: Born in Buffalo, New York, in 1958; her official biography describes her as born and raised in Western New York.
Earned a B.A. from Syracuse University in 1980 and a J.D. from the Catholic University of America.
Worked as an attorney in private practice and as an aide to Rep. John LaFalce (1984–1986) and Sen. Daniel Patrick Moynihan (1986–1988).
Began her public service on the Hamburg Town Board, to which she was appointed in January 1994 and on which she served until 2007.
Served as Deputy Clerk of Erie County (2003–2007) and then Clerk (2007–2011); she was appointed Clerk in 2007 and won election to the post in November 2007 and again in 2010.
Won a May 2011 special election to represent New York's 26th Congressional District and served in the U.S. House from 2011 to 2013; she lost re-election in 2012 to Chris Collins, 50.8% to 49.2%.

Elected Lieutenant Governor of New York as Andrew Cuomo's running mate in 2014 and 2018, serving 2015–2021; in that role she chaired the statewide Regional Economic Development Councils, according to her official biography.
Became the 57th Governor of New York in August 2021 upon Cuomo's resignation, the first woman to hold the office, and won a full term in 2022, defeating Lee Zeldin.
According to her official biography, she and her husband, Bill Hochul, have two children and two granddaughters.
